defects.label: fix
defects.summary: Stage taxonomy is inconsistent across requirements vs governance tool policy vs architecture (e.g., requirements omit WorkPlanning/PatchApply/IntegrateAndValidate). Without an explicit alignment, stage_handoff requirements and tool permissions risk misapplication.

evidence.quote: Intake → Generate → Validate → Review → Judge → Freeze
Intake → Parallel Lanes → Integration → Judge → Freeze

patch.value: The Implementation Council workflow SHALL be defined as a deterministic staged state machine with at minimum the stages: Intake → WorkPlanning → Generate → PatchApply → Validate → Review → Judge → Freeze; architectures with parallel lanes SHALL additionally include an explicit Integration (IntegrateAndValidate) stage between lane completion and Judge. The workflow SHALL include an explicit checkpoint boundary at every stage transition.
